requirement_text: "Illinois is test-optional, and you can choose whether to include ACT or SAT scores." In a test-optional review, the university places more weight on GPA, course rigor, essays, and extracurriculars for applicants who do not submit scores.
limitations: A direct WebFetch of this exact page returned no explicit test-optional statement in the fetched excerpt (only AP/IB credit-award mentions); the test-optional characterization is corroborated via WebSearch summarizing the same official domain's admissions pages, not confirmed by one single raw quote from this page.

requirement_text: "If you do not report ACT/SAT scores and have not completed years 10 through 12 in an approved country where English is the official language, you are required to submit TOEFL iBT, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test scores regardless of citizenship or residency." "Scores must be taken within two years of your enrollment date." Applicants must "submit one of the following test scores: ACT, SAT, TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English Test."
limitations: Exact minimum numeric scores for TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo were not locatable on this page in this environment (page confirms which tests are accepted and the 2-year validity window, but not the pass thresholds) -- direct curl of admissions.illinois.edu consistently returned 0 bytes from this environment (network-level, not a bot-block -- distinct from the User-Agent blocks seen at Durham/UVA/City-St-George's). Recorded as an honest gap rather than an estimated number.

requirement_text: Standard IELTS: "6.5 overall with 6.0 in each individual element (reading, writing, listening and speaking)" (higher-level courses use the same 6.5/6.0 structure, some courses require more, communicated in the offer). TOEFL iBT before 21 Jan 2026: "Overall score of 88, with not less than 21 in each test"; from 21 Jan 2026: "Overall score of 4.5 with not less than 4.5 in Writing and Listening and not less than 4.0 in Speaking and Reading" (ETS redesigned scale). PTE Academic: "Overall score of 65, with not less than 61 in each sub-test". Duolingo: "Overall score of 120 with not less than the following in each integrated and individual sub-test: Speaking 110, Writing 115, Reading 110, Listening 105". Cambridge English Advanced (CAE): "C/180". Cambridge English Proficiency (CPE): "C/200".
scope: university-wide standard; some courses require higher, stated in the offer letter
researcher_notes: Fourth confirmed sighting of the identical ETS TOEFL 21-Jan-2026 rescale boundary (after USC, Purdue in the prior package) -- now solidly established as an ETS-wide change, not institution-specific.
test_scale: dual: legacy 0-120 TOEFL scale pre-2026-01-21, new ETS scale post-2026-01-21

requirement_text: Per the university's Senate-approved regulation (Yönerge, Madde 5 & 7): international/foreign-national applicants to associate and undergraduate programmes apply exclusively online via https://yos.istanbul.edu.tr/tr/ using İÜYÖS (İstanbul Üniversitesi Yurtdışından veya Yabancı Uyruklu Öğrenci Sınavı). Exams/diplomas other than İÜYÖS and their required minimum scores are separately set by the University Senate (not enumerated in this regulation itself). "İÜYÖS yılda bir kez yapılır" (İÜYÖS is held once a year); results are "sınav tarihini izleyen bir (1) eğitim ve öğretim yılı için geçerlidir" (valid for the one academic year following the exam). Candidates may select up to 3 programme preferences.
limitations: This regulation (Yönerge) sets the legal/procedural framework but does not itself list the non-İÜYÖS equivalent exam names or their minimum scores (delegated to a separately-published Senate decision/Kılavuz not located this pass) -- recorded as unknown rather than guessed, unlike Ankara Üniversitesi's equivalent table which was directly located as a standalone PDF in the prior package.
researcher_notes: Identity trap avoided: 'Istanbul University' (istanbul.edu.tr, this record's subject, 124 programmes in the live DB) is a distinct institution from 'Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa' (iuc.edu.tr, split off in 2019/2020) and from Istanbul Technical University (itu.edu.tr) -- multiple search results and at least one secondary blog conflated these three under similar-sounding 'İÜYÖS'/'İYÖS' names; only istanbul.edu.tr/cdn.istanbul.edu.tr sources were used for this record.

requirement_text: Instruction language is Turkish university-wide (programmes with a foreign-language track use a separate placement test). Turkish proficiency is scored on a 6-band CEFR-aligned scale (Madde 14): C2 95-100 and C1 85-94 = "Türkçesi yeterli" (sufficient, direct enrollment); B2 75-84 = "Türkçesi kısa zamanda yeterli duruma gelebilir" (can become sufficient quickly -- enrolls with a mandatory Turkish course, must reach C1-C2 by the start of the 3rd academic year); B1 60-74, A2 30-59, A1 0-29 = "Türkçesi yetersiz"/"Türkçesi hiç yok" (insufficient/none -- mandatory Turkish course, same C1-C2-by-year-3 deadline). Students who fail to reach C1-C2 by the start of year 3 cannot continue their studies until they do.
scope: all programmes, including foreign-language-medium ones (Turkish proficiency is a separate, additional requirement, not waived by studying in English/another language)
researcher_notes: Same distinctive pattern as Ankara Üniversitesi's Turkish-proficiency requirement in the prior package (REQ-2026-08-23-ANK0003) -- a real, recurring fact class for Turkish public universities that a student targeting an English-medium programme could easily miss.

requirement_text: "The minimum score accepted for undergraduate courses is IELTS 6.0 with 5.5 in each component or equivalent. However, undergraduate applicants are required to achieve a minimum of IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each component or equivalent for direct entry." "Some academic departments may require a higher score." Tests must be "completed no more than two years before the start date" of the course. Successful completion of a Sheffield International Foundation Year or International Year One satisfies the requirement. Applicants with a recent degree taught in English in person in a majority native-English-speaking country are normally exempt from further evidence.
scope: general minimum 6.0/5.5 (foundation-year route); direct-entry minimum 6.5/6.0; individual departments may set higher
limitations: TOEFL/PTE/Duolingo-equivalent minimums for the 6.5/6.0 direct-entry band were not located on this specific page in this pass -- IELTS is the only test whose figures were directly confirmed.

requirement_text: "Applicants choosing not to submit standardized tests will not be at a disadvantage, nor will it negatively impact their application review or scholarship consideration." "At the University of Rochester test optional truly does mean test optional -- for all applications through all phases of the application process." Policy "extended... through at least fall 2027"; testing is not used as a factor for merit-based scholarships.

Typical undergraduate requirement: IELTS 6.0 overall with no band below 5.5 (some courses set higher, particularly business/humanities at 7.0). Postgraduate standard is higher (IELTS 6.5/6.0) and not the subject of this record.
scope: general undergraduate minimum; course-specific requirements vary
source_authority_note: Confirmed via WebSearch summarizing Leicester's own admissions pages rather than one single raw fetch of this exact URL in this pass.
limitations: Not independently confirmed via direct WebFetch/curl of an official le.ac.uk page in this pass -- sourced from WebSearch's synthesis across secondary aggregator sites (collegedunia, zollege, leapscholar) referencing the official domain, not a verbatim quote from the primary page itself. university_name: City St George's, University of London
requirement_text: English requirements are course-specific rather than one university-wide figure. Two structurally different bands exist: some courses require "overall IELTS 7.0 but no less than 6.0 in each sub-test" (English-as-a-second-language route accepted); others require "overall IELTS 7.0 and no less than 7.0 in each sub-test" (English-as-a-second-language route NOT accepted at this tier) -- "highly selective courses would require IELTS overall 7.0 with at least 7.0 in writing (for example, journalism or law)." General entry minimum: passes in two subjects at GCE A-level or equivalent, with full requirements published per course page.
scope: course-dependent; two distinct IELTS-band structures exist, not one flat number
source_authority_note: Confirmed via WebSearch synthesis, not a direct raw fetch -- both WebFetch and curl-with-browser-UA were blocked (403) on this domain in this pass, unlike Durham's dur.ac.uk which resolved with a UA change.

researcher_notes: City St George's is a 2024 merger of City, University of London and St George's, University of London -- worth double-checking the live DB's university_official_domain and name match this merged identity, not a pre-merger alias, if this gets ingested.

university_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
requirement_text: GPA-conditional testing requirement, effective "for students entering fall 2026 and beyond" under UNC System policy: "Students with a weighted GPA below 2.8 (on a 4.0 scale) are required to submit either an ACT score of 17 or higher or an SAT score of 930 or higher." "Students who have a weighted GPA of 2.80 or higher have the option to self-report SAT and/or ACT scores with their application." Applicants who do submit scores may use the ACT, the SAT, or the Classic Learning Test (CLT). This applies to both first-year and transfer applicants. Admitted students who self-reported scores must later submit official scores by a stated deadline.
researcher_notes: Structurally distinct from every other testing-policy record in both this package and the prior top-5 package -- neither 'test-optional' (Rochester, Emory, UVA, USC, UIUC) nor 'test expected' (Purdue) nor a flat requirement, but a GPA-triggered conditional mandate set at the UNC System level, not just this one campus. Worth its own policy-category value if the product ever encodes testing posture as a typed enum.

requirement_text: "Emory University has extended its test optional policy for applicants who plan to enroll as first-year students in Fall 2027. scope: both Emory College and Oxford College
